summary: Operator enterprise tested on ROSA HCP 4.15.16 with 2 t3.xlarge workers in different AZs, ansible-core 2.16+, AWS RDS PostgreSQL 15 (db.t4g.small, multi-AZ, encrypted gp2, ICU). External database minimum: 4 vCPUs, 16 GB RAM, max_connections 1024, 200 GB on 3000 IOPS storage; monitor usage and schedule cleanup jobs.
questions: What are the minimum external database requirements for the AAP enterprise topology?
What max_connections does AAP enterprise need on PostgreSQL?
Which AWS RDS settings were tested for AAP on ROSA?

answer_card.title: External database minimum for Operator enterprise
answer_card.answer_md:
- 4 vCPUs
- 16 GB RAM
- `max_connections` at least 1024 (more when scaling replicas)
- 200 GB storage on a volume with at least 3000 IOPS
- ICU support

Start at 200 GB, monitor usage, and configure cleanup jobs to stop unbounded growth.
